mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the medically important groups of trematodes that inhabit different tissues and organs of their hosts."
Digenetic trematodes are the medically important groups of trematodes that inhabit different tissues and organs of their hosts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the second larval form to develop within the molluscan host (but may be absent in some groups, such as the schistosomes)."
The redia are the second larval form to develop within the molluscan host (but may be absent in some groups, such as the schistosomes).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the name of the ciliated larval stage that is hatched from the digenean egg."
The miracidium is the name of the ciliated larval stage that is hatched from the digenean egg.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a ubiquitous parasite of man."
The human pinworm Enterobius vermicularis is a ubiquitous parasite of man.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the more well-known members of the Subclass Eucestoda which are parasites of both warm and cold blooded vertebrates, including mammals such as man."
Secondly is the more well-known members of the Subclass Eucestoda which are parasites of both warm and cold blooded vertebrates, including mammals such as man.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a a zoonotic disease caused by infection with F. hepatica."
Fascioliasis is a a zoonotic disease caused by infection with F. hepatica.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a syncytial layer, showing many features typical of that found in other parasitic platyhelminthes."
The cesode tegument is a syncytial layer, showing many features typical of that found in other parasitic platyhelminthes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a roundworm found in goats and cattles."
Ascaris lumbricoides - is a roundworm found in goats and cattles.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a reproductive process or life cycle stages in insects that involves the egg , the larva, the pupa and the adult."
Complete metamorphosis is a reproductive process or life cycle stages in insects that involves the egg , the larva, the pupa and the adult.
